dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL, NOS), germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB) subtype by the Hans algorithm, involving the right cervical lymph nodes at levels II and III.

stage_i.quote: Stage IA (Ann Arbor), limited-stage, non-bulky. FDG PET-CT (2026-09-03) shows a cluster of FDG-avid right cervical nodes at levels II and III, contiguous within a single nodal region

stage_nonbulky_no_b.quote: She has no B symptoms (no fever, drenching night sweats, or weight loss).

stage_pet_no_marrow_biopsy.quote: Bone marrow biopsy is not required because PET shows no marrow uptake.

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: BCL2 is positive in about 30% and MYC in about 15% of cells, which is below the usual thresholds for double-expressor DLBCL (BCL2 >=40% and MYC >=40%). FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma.

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: which is below the usual thresholds for double-expressor DLBCL (BCL2 >=40% and MYC >=40%)

prog_ipi_low.quote: The age-adjusted IPI is 0 (age <60, stage I, LDH 190 U/L [normal 135-225], ECOG 0, no extranodal sites).

prog_cns_ipi_low.quote: Her CNS-IPI is 0 (age <=60, ECOG 0, normal LDH, no more than one extranodal site, and no kidney/adrenal involvement), which corresponds to a very low risk of CNS relapse

tx_curative_rchop.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP21 for four cycles, without involved-site radiation.

tx_flyer_4rchop_2r.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP21 for four cycles, without involved-site radiation. ... repeat every 21 days for 4 cycles.

tx_no_rt_goals.quote: I am deliberately omitting ISRT because she has non-bulky stage I disease and strongly wishes to avoid neck radiation given her sister's radiation-related hypothyroidism and her concerns about dry mouth and taste

tx_alternatives.quote: The main shared decision is four cycles of R-CHOP alone versus three cycles of R-CHOP plus involved-site radiation

mn_six_cycles.quote: I would not use 6 cycles of R-CHOP, Pola-R-CHP, or chemotherapy alone with fewer than 4 cycles.

mn_pola_preferred.quote: I would not use 6 cycles of R-CHOP, Pola-R-CHP, or chemotherapy alone with fewer than 4 cycles.

mn_da_epoch.quote: If a reference review unexpectedly showed double-hit lymphoma, I would use a more intensive regimen such as DA-EPOCH-R rather than R-CHOP.

mn_observation_or_rt_alone.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP21 for four cycles, without involved-site radiation.

cns_low_no_prophylaxis.quote: Low risk; no CNS prophylaxis indicated. Her CNS-IPI is 0 (age <=60, ECOG 0, normal LDH, no more than one extranodal site, and no kidney/adrenal involvement)

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: I would not give intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment FDG PET-CT, ideally 6-8 weeks after cycle 4 and not sooner than about 3 weeks after the last chemotherapy, interpreted by Lugano 2014 criteria using the Deauville 5-point scale.

resp_interim_pet.quote: I would not do an interim PET outside a clinical trial.

work_pregnancy_test.quote: Before cycle 1, I still need a serum pregnancy test (she is premenopausal on a combined oral contraceptive)

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: hepatitis B panel (HBsAg negative, anti-HBc negative, anti-HBs reactive, consistent with vaccine immunity)

work_echo_reviewed.quote: baseline transthoracic echocardiogram with LVEF 63% and normal strain

sup_stop_coc_switch.quote: Stop the combined ethinyl estradiol/levonorgestrel oral contraceptive now. Migraine with aura is a WHO category 4 contraindication to combined hormonal contraception

sup_coc_reason.quote: Migraine with aura is a WHO category 4 contraindication to combined hormonal contraception, and active cancer plus chemotherapy further increases venous thromboembolism risk.

sup_fertility_counselling.quote: She is undecided about another pregnancy, so fertility preservation should be arranged urgently before cyclophosphamide exposure.

fit_goals.quote: She is fully fit for full-dose, curative-intent therapy: age 45, ECOG 0, normal organ function, LVEF 63%, no cardiac or other major comorbidity, and she works full time as a third-grade teacher.
